definitions.gloss: number of votes; vote count; ballot count
definitions.explanation: The total number of votes cast in an election, poll, or any kind of voting process. Frequently used in news reporting about elections and surveys.

examples.japanese: {投票数|とうひょうすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{過去最高|かこさいこう}だった。
examples.english: The number of votes was the highest ever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧{投票数|とうひょうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They obtained a majority of the valid votes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{投票数|とうひょうすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}→有権者：13021_yuukensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うかがえた→うかがう：01273_ukagau⟧。
examples.english: In this election, the vote count increased significantly compared to last time, indicating the high level of interest among eligible voters.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧ (voting; casting a ballot) and ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number; count). A standard term in political reporting and election coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投票数|とうひょうすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: the vote count increases
- {投票数|とうひょうすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: the vote count decreases
- ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧{投票数|とうひょうすう}: number of valid votes
- ⟦{無効|むこう}→無効：13385_mukou⟧{投票数|とうひょうすう}: number of invalid votes
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{投票数|とうひょうすう}: total number of votes

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{投票率|とうひょうりつ}→投票率：22200_touhyouritsu⟧: voter turnout rate
- ⟦{得票数|とくひょうすう}→得票数：25148_tokuhyousuu⟧: number of votes received (by a candidate)
- ⟦{開票|かいひょう}→開票：19117_kaihyou⟧: vote counting; ballot opening
